name: Sumo deadlift
instructions: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and the bar over your mid-foot.
Sit your hips down, grip the bar inside your knees, and brace your core.
Push the floor apart with your feet until you stand tall.
Hinge back and lower the bar down your legs to the floor.
cue: Brace, chest up, spread the floor
mistakes: Letting the knees cave in as you pull.
Rounding the upper back at the start.
